svg.title: From repository to a running app
svg.desc: Read each row left to right, then continue down. Steps 1-3 configure a derived repository, approve the Entra-only identity plan, and obtain administrator consent and user sign-in. Steps 4-6 approve the untargeted platform plan, synchronize all five DEV items with Bootstrap explicitly attached, and verify local data and physical item IDs. Steps 7-9 approve the full knowledge plan, prove indexed and live retrieval, and report DEV ready only with evidence. Step 10 creates, connects, configures and publishes the Studio agent, registers the Managed Runtime app, and verifies the App Player experience with separate approvals and user OAuth. TEST promotion, hosted deployment and second-user isolation remain separate.

g.text: From repository to a running app
One checkout, one tfvars file, one backend. Human approvals stay explicit.
Only this plan may be targeted.
Sign in; verify actual Fabric roles.
Stop on failure; keep resume point.
Verify the App Player challenge, a live answer and a follow-up.
Three saved-plan approvals do not replace consent, Git review or agent/app approvals.
TEST promotion, hosted app deployment and second-user isolation are separate gates.
